content.comment_body: I'm interested in using a 12 VDC [product_name] to monitor pressure, but I'm unsure which option to choose. Should I use a pressure transmitter or is it possible to work with a pressure switch and the unit? It seems there are very few pressure transmitters that are compatible with a standard 12 VDC [product_name] using a 0-10VDC output, as most require 16VDC or higher power. The [product_name] apparently doesn't support 4-20mA inputs without an additional module. Any advice would be appreciated. Just to note, I have no prior experience with a [product_name] and haven't acquired one yet.

Hello [user_name], I haven't worked with [product_name] PLC, but generally, if you need a voltage range instead of mA, you can use a resistor. For instance, if you have a pressure transmitter sending 4-20mA, you can pass this current through a 500 Ohm resistor: 4mA x 500 = 2V, 20mA x 500 = 10V. This way, you can convert the channel signal to a range from 2 to 10V. Hope this is helpful.
Hi [user_name], additionally, to convert 0/4-20mA to 0-10V inputs.

There are many types of pressure sensors you can use with [product_name]. If you have a DC version (12/24V), the [product_name] should operate with either 12V or 24V DC. Make sure your sensor outputs 0-10V or 2-10V. You can also use sensors with a 4 (0)-20mA output. For these, connect a simple 500 Ohm resistor between the analog input and ground/power negative. This converts the 4-20mA signal into a 2-10V range, which works directly in your program. You can use multiple analog inputs as needed in your configuration. There are also expansion modules you can attach to the [product_name] for 0-10V and 4-20mA signals. These expansion modules always operate on 24VDC.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking guidance on integrating pressure sensors with [product_name], especially concerning power requirements and input signal compatibility. There’s uncertainty since most pressure transmitters require more than 12VDC, and 4-20mA signals need an extra module. Contributors describe using a resistor to convert 4-20mA signals and mention expansion modules for easier connection. Overall, users feel they need clearer documentation and support about sensor compatibility when working with entry-level [product_name] systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want straightforward integration between pressure sensors and [product_name], along with clear recommendations for compatible sensor types and input methods.
